title: narcissus × johnstonii
intro: Narcissus × johnstonii, commonly known as the Johnson's narcissus, is a hybrid plant that is derived from the cross between Narcissus pseudonarcissus and Narcissus obsoletus. This plant is valued for its therapeutic properties and is used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety and depression, and improve sleep quality. The health benefits of Narcissus × johnstonii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as insomnia, stress, and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its sedative and anxiolytic effects.
